compatibility.notes: No project-format or settings migration is introduced by this release. Previous-version reopening is not applicable; a separate project-folder backup remains recommended before early-adopter use.

rollback.application: No earlier formal Twine RS binary exists; uninstall or discontinue using this prerelease and return to the application used before Twine RS.
rollback.projectData: Stop editing the affected project, then restore the separate pre-adoption project-folder backup when recovery is required.

knownIssues: In the current benchmark suite, some latency and memory results at the largest tested project sizes exceed the project’s initial performance targets.
Advanced Harlowe syntax editing is specific to the bundled Harlowe 3.3.9 format; other Harlowe versions use the generic editor.
Package export records an asset copy plan but does not bundle project asset bytes; desktop Playable HTML export can embed supported statically referenced media.
Some inherited compatibility user interface and documentation remain outside the primary Twine RS workbench.
Cross-platform packaged-app and hosted-CI performance coverage remains incomplete.
